title: HubSpot and WhatsApp Integration
seoTitle: HubSpot WhatsApp Integration: Chats, Templates and Workflows
seoDescription: Connect WhatsApp to HubSpot to chat from the inbox, log conversations on contacts and send template messages from workflows. Options, plans and set-up.
summary: A HubSpot–WhatsApp integration connects a WhatsApp Business number to HubSpot so teams can reply to WhatsApp chats from the HubSpot inbox, log every conversation on the contact record and send approved template messages from workflows, such as a follow-up after a demo.

dataPoints.label: Options
dataPoints.value: HubSpot's native WhatsApp channel on eligible paid plans, or marketplace apps

dataPoints.label: WhatsApp side
dataPoints.value: WhatsApp Business Platform number with approved templates

dataPoints.label: Logged in HubSpot
dataPoints.value: Messages and replies on the contact timeline

dataPoints.label: Automation
dataPoints.value: Template messages triggered from HubSpot workflows

dataPoints.label: Typical effort
dataPoints.value: Days to set up; longer when templates and workflows are designed together

body:
## Good first workflows

1. Acknowledge new leads on WhatsApp within minutes.
2. Remind contacts of booked meetings.
3. Follow up after a quote with a helpful resource.

## Consent and quality

Record opt-in, keep marketing templates relevant, and watch your number's quality rating. See [WhatsApp or a dedicated app](/blog/whatsapp-or-a-dedicated-app-choosing-the-right-channel).

faqs.a: The native channel is limited to certain paid tiers; check HubSpot's current plan details or use a marketplace app.

faqs.q: Can multiple salespeople use one WhatsApp number?
faqs.a: Yes, through the shared HubSpot inbox with conversations assigned to owners.
